latestAction.text: Resolution agreed to in Senate without amendment and with a preamble by Unanimous Consent. (consideration: CR S8454)

summary.text: This resolution designates November 30, 2025, as Drive Safer Sunday. It also encourages all people of the United States to use the Sunday after Thanksgiving as an opportunity to educate themselves about highway safety.

title: A resolution designating November 30, 2025, as "Drive Safer Sunday".
